tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: House. The page ground and every light section that alternates with sand. Text on it: ink (16.9:1), ink-soft (7.6:1). Actions on it: ink pills.

tokens.name: sand
tokens.usage: House. The second light section ground: neighbouring sections alternate paper and sand, never the same twice. White tiles and panels sit on sand. Text on it: ink (14.4:1), ink-soft (6.5:1). Actions on it: ink pills.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: House. Tiles, panels, the label frame, table bodies and field fills. Put white on sand or behind a shadow; white on paper alone is too faint to read as a shape. Text on it: ink (18.6:1), ink-soft (8.3:1).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: House. All text on light grounds, the primary pill on light grounds, the dark section ground (token section, footer, RUO bar) and the selected state of chips. Text on ink: paper (16.9:1), white, paper-soft (10.5:1). Actions on ink: paper pills. Never put a tricolor block on ink: the deep band disappears into it.

tokens.name: ink-raised
tokens.usage: House. Tiles and panels on an ink ground. Text on it: paper (14.7:1), paper-soft (9.1:1).

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: House. Secondary text on paper, sand and white: asides, notes, captions, field labels (6.5:1 or more). Also the border of text fields.

tokens.name: paper-soft
tokens.usage: House. Secondary text on ink and ink-raised (9.1:1 or more).

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: House. Hairlines inside a component only: table rows and list dividers on white. Never between sections: a section changes ground instead. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: line-ink
tokens.usage: House. Hairlines inside a component on ink or ink-raised. Carries no meaning.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The dimmed page behind the product drawer, the cart and dialogs.

tokens.name: metabolic-light
tokens.usage: Identity. Metabolic research, light band: brand, number and area. Text on it: metabolic-deep (9.4:1). Actions on it: ink pills (11.3:1).

tokens.name: metabolic-bright
tokens.usage: Identity. Metabolic research, bright band: the compound. Text on it: white (6.6:1). Actions on it: paper pills (6.0:1), the one bright band where ink pills are too dark.

tokens.name: metabolic-deep
tokens.usage: Identity. Metabolic research, deep band: the rules (research use, lot, storage). Text on it: white (15.4:1), metabolic-light (9.4:1). Actions on it: paper pills.

tokens.name: tissue-light
tokens.usage: Identity. Tissue research, light band. Text on it: tissue-deep (9.1:1). Actions on it: ink pills.

tokens.name: tissue-bright
tokens.usage: Identity. Tissue research, bright band. Text on it: white at 24px and up, or 19px at 800 (3.6:1). Actions on it: ink pills (5.1:1).

tokens.name: tissue-deep
tokens.usage: Identity. Tissue research, deep band. Text on it: white (12.6:1), tissue-light (9.1:1). Actions on it: paper pills.

tokens.name: dermal-light
tokens.usage: Identity. Dermal research, light band. Text on it: dermal-deep (5.0:1). Actions on it: ink pills.

tokens.name: dermal-bright
tokens.usage: Identity. Dermal research, bright band. Text on it: white at 24px and up, or 19px at 800 (3.1:1). Actions on it: ink pills (6.0:1).

tokens.name: dermal-deep
tokens.usage: Identity. Dermal research, deep band. Text on it: white (8.1:1), dermal-light (5.0:1). Actions on it: paper pills.

tokens.name: endocrine-light
tokens.usage: Identity. Endocrine research, light band. Text on it: endocrine-deep (8.1:1). Actions on it: ink pills.

tokens.name: endocrine-bright
tokens.usage: Identity. Endocrine research, bright band. Text on it: endocrine-deep (4.8:1), never white. Actions on it: ink pills (9.0:1).

tokens.name: endocrine-deep
tokens.usage: Identity. Endocrine research, deep band. Text on it: white (9.9:1), endocrine-light (8.1:1). Actions on it: paper pills.

tokens.name: on-metabolic-bright
tokens.usage: Text and marks on metabolic-bright (6.6:1).

tokens.name: on-tissue-bright
tokens.usage: Text and marks on tissue-bright: display sizes only (3.6:1).

tokens.name: on-dermal-bright
tokens.usage: Text and marks on dermal-bright: display sizes only (3.1:1).

tokens.name: on-endocrine-bright
tokens.usage: Text and marks on endocrine-bright (4.8:1).

families.mono: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: giant
styles.usage: The featured compound's short name in the hero's bright band, fitted to its width (96px on phones). Once per page.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The hero headline. Once per page. 44px on phones.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Compound names on cards and in the drawer, set names, sub-section titles (h3). 32px on phones.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Tile and step titles, panel headings, the full compound line on cards (h4).

styles.name: lead
styles.sample: Six research compounds, each in the three tones of its research area.
styles.usage: The one paragraph under a headline or section title. 62 characters a line at most. 18px on phones.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Every lot is tested by HPLC and mass spectrometry.

styles.name: kicker
styles.usage: Eyebrows over titles and the area line on bands, typed in capitals.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Pill buttons and header links, typed in capitals. Never used for anything that is not clickable.

styles.name: chip
styles.usage: Chip labels (filters and the hero's area switch), sentence case.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Prices, lot codes, dates, quantities, wallet balances. Tabular figures.

styles.name: tag
styles.usage: Square tags: status, N° and area tags on bands, Example data, Proposal. Typed in capitals.

tokens.name: band-gap
tokens.usage: The gap between the three bands of a tricolor block, and between the bands of a card. The ground shows through it. Never used between sections.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside tags; between a swatch's bars.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its value; between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between pills in a row; inside table cells on phones.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Page gutter on phones; grid gap on phones; band padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Band padding on cards; grid gap on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Panel padding; between a title and its content inside a block.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content on phones; between blocks inside a section on phones.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Between a section header and its content; between blocks inside a section.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom, on phones.

tokens.name: space-32
tokens.usage: Section padding, top and bottom, on desktop.

tokens.name: radius-square
tokens.usage: Everything you read: bands, cards, tiles, images, panels, tables, tags, notices. ZUMA's content is square.

tokens.name: radius-option
tokens.usage: Choices that take more than one line: size options, the order-frequency rows, the confirm row at checkout.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Everything you press: buttons, chips, the cart button, the quantity stepper, single-line fields. If it is round-ended, it is clickable.

tokens.name: shadow-lift
tokens.usage: A clickable card on hover, with a 6px rise. Cards that are not clickable never lift.

tokens.name: shadow-pill
tokens.usage: A pill on hover, with a 2px rise.

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The product drawer, the cart, dialogs and the referral dashboard preview.

tokens.name: shadow-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header once the page has scrolled.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: The widest a section's content runs, gutters included.

tokens.name: measure
tokens.usage: The longest line of running text.

tokens.name: hit-min
tokens.usage: The smallest height or width of anything clickable.

tokens.name: bp-phone
tokens.usage: Phone layout at this width and below: one column, 16px gutters, 80px section padding.

tokens.name: bp-tablet
tokens.usage: Tablet layout at this width and below: two columns for cards.

tokens.name: bp-nav
tokens.usage: At this width and below the header links fold into the Menu pill.

tokens.name: layer-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header.

tokens.name: layer-scrim
tokens.usage: The scrim behind panels.

tokens.name: layer-panel
tokens.usage: The product drawer and the cart.

tokens.name: layer-dialog
tokens.usage: The Coming at launch dialog.

tokens.name: layer-toast
tokens.usage: The Added to cart toast.
